Root causes of the failed PILOT-2->PILOT-3 live LLM job (ivx-worker-efb46ee9):

1. TS1470 FALSE-POSITIVE in scoped typecheck: the engine ran
   `tsc --noEmit --module nodenext` on changed files, but nodenext
   rejects `import.meta` (used at line 310 of the engine file and many
   backend modules) with TS1470. Every LLM patch that touched a file
   using import.meta was falsely rejected as a type error, so the loop
   revised until MAX_ITERATIONS and returned BLOCKED with no commit.
   FIX: switch all scoped typecheck commands to
   `--module esnext --moduleResolution bundler`, which allows
   import.meta (valid in the actual node+tsx / bun runtime) while still
   catching REAL type errors (verified with an injected type error).

   bug #1. FIX: generalize the fallback to ANY adjacent transition

   two distinct adjacent pilot labels; findPilotSentinelFile() builds a
   definition regex for the FROM label; deterministicPilotFallback()
   applies the exact-replacement. The controlled-pilot invariant
   (single sentinel-definition file, adjacent-only transition) is
   preserved.

   failed job had result=null. FIX: wrap runIVXAutonomousCoder in a
   top-level try/catch that converts any thrown error into a FAILED
   proof with the error message, so the worker always stores a full
   proof with diagnostic state.
